title: Data Analyst - Retail Media Insights
description:
We're working with a leading UK retailer looking to hire a Retail Media Data Analyst to join their growing Analytics team.

This role will focus on using customer data to drive retail media performance, campaign effectiveness and commercial growth. You'll work closely with Retail Media, CRM, Loyalty and Commercial teams to build customer audiences, measure campaign performance, identify trends and deliver actionable insights that improve customer engagement and maximise ROI.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a strong analytics background who enjoys turning complex data into clear business recommendations and influencing key commercial decisions.

Key Skills & Experience

  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
  • Experience using Python and/or R for analysis and reporting
  • Background in customer, CRM, marketing or campaign analytics
  • Experience measuring campaign performance, ROI and customer behaviour
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery or similar analytics platforms
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience presenting insights and recommendations to business users

Desirable

  • Experience within Retail Media, ecommerce, loyalty or customer marketing environments
